deltas.summary: The upstream GitHub governed-execution contract defaults to branch/PR delivery and forbids autonomous direct default-branch edits. AIOS-Tools used explicit bounded owner-authorized direct-main exceptions during rollout and repair. Repository law still keeps branch/PR delivery as the default; those exceptions remain historical and non-reusable.

Upstream verifier-owned acceptance requires exact task/artifact/head identity for acceptance-owning evidence. AIOS-Tools now binds acceptance-relevant workflow checkout directly to github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha, immediately verifies git rev-parse HEAD, validates generic Actions semantics with actionlint, enforces generic workflow security with blocking zizmor, and reserves the AIOS policy verifier for exact-head identity, self-trigger observability, execution-context, and evidence-binding obligations. LESSON-AIOS-TOOLS-001 is PROMOTED and the historical PR #59 repair was superseded by the owner-authorized main implementation.
